pomodoroTimer.title: Pomodoro Timer
pomodoroTimer.description: Set focus and break times, pause and resume. Check your daily goal, tasks, seven-day records and return guidance together.
pomodoroTimer.notificationBreakDone: Break over! Time to focus again.
pomodoroTimer.taskEmpty: No tasks yet. Add one above.
guideHowItems: Choose a task, focus and break durations, and a daily goal.
Start, pause when needed, and explicitly resume.
After the current phase ends, start a break or the next focus phase. Auto-start is optional in settings.
On return, check remaining time or the expired-session notice. Away time is not automatically recorded.
Review completed focus sessions and download the last seven days as CSV.
guideTipsItems: Alerts depend on browser and operating-system background execution limits.
If time sources have changed substantially, check the remaining time and phase before resuming.
Corrupt or inaccessible settings, task and timer data are preserved while you use the current screen.
The timer stops if another tab changes its saved state. Review the notice and explicitly reload it.
Skipping or returning to an already-expired saved phase does not automatically add a completed focus session.

goal.title: Today's focus goal
goal.remaining: {count} more focus sessions to reach your goal.
goal.label: Daily session goal
goal.scope: Save a goal of 1–20 sessions in this browser. Only finished focus sessions count; running sessions, breaks, and skips do not. Changing the goal keeps the timer running.
goal.exportNote: Exports the last seven days including today, using this device's local calendar dates. Records for the same date are added together. Task text is not included.
goal.otherSaveFailed: Some timer, setting, or task changes could not be saved in this browser. They remain on screen, but refreshing may lose recent changes. Check browser storage space and settings.

errors.invalid: Enter a whole-number daily goal between 1 and 20.
errors.corrupt: The saved goal could not be read, so a temporary default of four is shown. Existing data was not overwritten. Check the saved data and reload it.
errors.unavailable: The goal could not be read or saved. Your entered goal is preserved. Check browser storage space and settings, then try again.
errors.conflict: Another window changed the goal. Your entered goal is preserved. Reload the saved goal before saving again.

statsErrors.corrupt: Saved focus records contain unreadable dates or counts, so existing data was preserved and saving paused. Invalid or future dates and negative values are not accepted. Newly completed sessions appear only on this screen.
statsErrors.unavailable: Saved focus records are unavailable. New records on this screen are not saved in the browser, so take care before refreshing.
statsErrors.failed: Focus records could not be saved. They remain on screen and can be downloaded as CSV. Check storage space and try again.
statsErrors.conflict: Another window changed the focus records, so overwriting was stopped. Download this screen's records as CSV before refreshing. The CSV contains only records shown here.

notices.saved: Daily goal saved. The timer is unchanged.
notices.downloaded: Started downloading the last seven days of focus records as CSV.
notices.downloadFailed: Could not create the CSV file. Your current records are unchanged. Please try again.

reliability.restoredExpired: The previously running phase has expired. Time away was not added to completed sessions or tasks.
reliability.advanceHint: An expired work phase moves to a short break. No completion record is added for the previous phase.
reliability.clockChanged: The time reference changed, so the timer was paused. Check the remaining time before starting again.
reliability.clockGapExpired: The time references differ, so this phase's completion cannot be confirmed. You can move to the next phase without adding a completion record.
reliability.conflict: Another tab changed the saved timer, so this timer was paused. No completion record was added for this phase.
reliability.unconfirmed: The timer's saved state could not be confirmed, so it was paused. Reload the saved state to check it.
reliability.counterLimit: The accumulated count exceeded the supported range, so the timer stopped. Reset the session before starting again.
reliability.timeHint: Remaining time excludes pauses. Alerts may be delayed while the tab or device is suspended.
reliability.corrupt: The saved {item} has an unreadable format. The original is preserved and automatic saving for this item is paused.
reliability.unsupported: The saved {item} uses an unsupported version. The original is preserved and automatic saving is paused.
reliability.oversized: The saved {item} exceeds the reading limit. The original is preserved and automatic saving is paused.
reliability.unavailable: Storage for {item} is unavailable. Changes on this screen may not remain when you return.
reliability.quota: There is not enough storage to save {item}. Your input remains on this screen.
reliability.saveConflict: The saved {item} changed elsewhere. Your current input is preserved and automatic saving is paused.
reliability.saveUnconfirmed: The save result for {item} could not be confirmed. It may already be saved; reload it to check.
reliability.invalid: The current {item} cannot be saved. Check your input.
reliability.reloadConfirm: Reloading will replace {item} on this screen with the saved state. Continue?
reliability.discardConfirm: Delete the saved {item} from this browser? Other saved items will be kept.
reliability.discarded: The saved state was deleted. Your current input is unchanged.
reliability.canceled: The pending save was canceled. Your current input is unchanged.
